steps.title: Transform E. coli with plasmids
steps.instruction: Mix 100 µl of chemically competent E. coli BL21‑CodonPlus(DE3)‑RIPL cells with 1–10 ng of pET15b‑sfGFP‑MinD or pET29‑minE‑mCherry‑His plasmid on ice for 30 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 1 min, chill on ice, add 400 µl SOB medium and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Plate and select transformants
steps.instruction: Plate the recovered cells on LB agar containing 100 µg ml⁻¹ ampicillin for MinD or 25 µg ml⁻¹ kanamycin for MinE and incubate at 37 °C for 12–18 h.

steps.title: Inoculate starter culture
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony, inoculate into 4 ml LB with the same antibiotic (100 µg ml⁻¹ ampicillin or 25 µg ml⁻¹ kanamycin) and grow at 37 °C for 12–18 h.

steps.title: Scale‑up and induce expression
steps.instruction: Transfer 2 ml of the starter culture into 200 ml LB with the appropriate antibiotic, grow at 37 °C, 180 rpm (MinD) or 16 °C, 120 rpm (MinE). Add IPTG to a final concentration of 1 mM when OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.1–0.2 (MinD) or 0.6–0.7 (MinE). Continue cultivation for 3–4 h (MinD) or 12 h (MinE).

steps.title: Harvest and store cells
steps.instruction: Transfer cultures to 50 ml centrifuge tubes and centrifuge at 8 000 × g, 4 °C for 2 min. Remove supernatant and store cell pellets at –80 °C (optional pause point).

steps.title: Purify His‑sfGFP‑MinD
steps.instruction: Suspend frozen MinD cells in 4 ml LS‑ADP buffer, sonicate (Sonifier Analog Series, duty 30 %, output 3) for 30 min, centrifuge at 20 000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min, mix supernatant with 500 µl cOmplete His‑Tag resin at 4 °C for 30 min with gentle rotation, load onto a Polyprep column, wash with 25 ml WS buffer, elute with 2 ml EL buffer, exchange into storage buffer (0.2 mM ADP) using AmiconUltra‑15 30 k filter: add 8 ml storage buffer, centrifuge at 4 000 × g, 4 °C until volume <2 ml (30–60 min), repeat concentration step 5–6 times, transfer to AmiconUltra‑0.5 30 k filter and centrifuge at 14 000 × g, 4 °C for ~30 min to <0.1 ml, assess purity by CBB‑stained SDS‑PAGE and BCA assay, adjust to 100 µM with storage buffer and store at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Bind to 500 µl His‑Tag resin, 4 °C, 30 min rotating
Load onto column, wash 25 ml WS buffer
Buffer exchange with AmiconUltra‑15 30 k (add 8 ml storage buffer, centrifuge 4 000 × g, 4 °C to <2 ml, repeat 5–6×)
Concentrate with AmiconUltra‑0.5 30 k (14 000 × g, 4 °C, ~30 min to <0.1 ml)

steps.title: Purify MinE‑mCherry‑His
steps.instruction: Suspend frozen MinE cells in 4 ml LS buffer, sonicate (duty 30 % with 0.3 s ON/0.7 s OFF cycles, output 3) for 30 min, centrifuge at 20 000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min, bind supernatant to 500 µl His‑Tag resin at 4 °C for 30 min rotating, load onto Polyprep column, wash with 25 ml WS buffer, elute with 2 ml EL buffer, dilute eluate 5–10‑fold with HG buffer, apply to HiTrap Q HP column equilibrated with IEX‑A buffer on AKTA start, perform ion‑exchange wash with IEX‑A and gradient elution with IEX‑A/IEX‑B, collect peak fractions (identified by SDS‑PAGE), exchange into storage buffer using AmiconUltra‑15 10 k filter (add 8 ml storage buffer, centrifuge 4 000 × g, 4 °C to <2 ml, repeat 5–6×), concentrate with AmiconUltra‑0.5 10 k filter (14 000 × g, 4 °C, ~30 min to <0.1 ml), assess purity (CBB SDS‑PAGE, BCA), adjust to 100 µM with storage buffer and store at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate 30 min (duty 30 %, 0.3 s ON/0.7 s OFF, output 3)
Bind to 500 µl His‑Tag resin, 4 °C, 30 min rotating
Load onto column, wash 25 ml WS buffer
Ion‑exchange on HiTrap Q HP (equilibrate IEX‑A, wash IEX‑A, gradient elution IEX‑A/IEX‑B)
Buffer exchange with AmiconUltra‑15 10 k (add 8 ml storage buffer, centrifuge 4 000 × g, 4 °C to <2 ml, repeat 5–6×)
Concentrate with AmiconUltra‑0.5 10 k (14 000 × g, 4 °C, ~30 min to <0.1 ml)

steps.title: Prepare washed BSA solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 100–200 mg BSA into a 15 ml tube, add 10 ml ultrapure water and vortex to dissolve, transfer to AmiconUltra‑15 50 k filter and centrifuge at 4 000 × g, 4 °C until volume <2 ml (30–60 min), add 8 ml RE buffer, repeat concentration/dilution 5–6 times, concentrate to <2 ml (4 000 × g, 4 °C), transfer to AmiconUltra‑0.5 50 k filter and centrifuge at 14 000 × g, 4 °C for 30 min to <0.3 ml, determine concentration by BCA assay, store in storage buffer at room temperature (typical 300–400 mg ml⁻¹, renew monthly).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 100–200 mg BSA in 10 ml water
Concentrate with AmiconUltra‑15 50 k (4 000 × g, 4 °C, <2 ml)
Transfer to AmiconUltra‑0.5 50 k, centrifuge 14 000 × g, 4 °C, 30 min to <0.3 ml
Store at RT in storage buffer

steps.title: Quantify proteins by CBB staining
steps.instruction: Load samples and BSA standards (200, 400, 600, 800, 1 000 ng) onto a 12.5 % SDS‑PAGE gel (use 12.5 % or 15 % acrylamide with 1/37.5 N,N′‑Methylenebisacrylamide for His‑sfGFP‑MinD or MinE‑mCherry‑His respectively), run at 20 mA for 60 min, stain with CBB solution at room temperature for 30 min, destain in water at room temperature for 30 min, image with ChemDoc Touch MP, measure band intensities with Fiji to generate a standard curve, and calculate sample concentrations from the curve.

substeps.instruction: Prepare gel (12.5 % or 15 % acrylamide, appropriate bis‑acrylamide ratio)
Load samples and BSA standards (200–1 000 ng)
Analyze bands (Fiji) to build standard curve

steps.title: Prepare lipid oil for microdroplets
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl of 25 mg ml⁻¹ E. coli polar lipid extract (total 1 mg) to a round glass microtube, dry under gentle argon flow, add 1 ml mineral oil to achieve 1 mg ml⁻¹ lipid concentration, seal with DuraSeal, sonicate at 60 °C for 90 min using a Bransonic bath, vortex 1 min at room temperature, and store the lipid oil at room temperature for use the same day (do not chill or refrigerate).

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µl lipid extract (25 mg ml⁻¹) to glass tube
Add 1 ml mineral oil (final 1 mg ml⁻¹)
Store at RT, use within the day

steps.title: Form protein‑containing microdroplets
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 ml tube, prepare a reaction mixture containing 1 µM (0.58 mg ml⁻¹) His‑sfGFP‑MinD, 1 µM (0.38 mg ml⁻¹) MinE‑mCherry‑His, 2.5 mM ATP, and 100 mg ml⁻¹ washed BSA in RE buffer. Add 100 µl lipid oil to a 0.6 ml tube, pipette 2 µl of the reaction mixture into the oil, and gently tap the tube about 10 times to emulsify.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix (1 µM MinD, 1 µM MinE, 2.5 mM ATP, 100 mg ml⁻¹ BSA in RE buffer)
Add 100 µl lipid oil to 0.6 ml tube

steps.title: Assemble chamber and observe Min dynamics
steps.instruction: Place two cover glasses (25 × 36 mm and 18 × 18 mm) on a microscope slide, create a chamber using double‑sided tape (~90 µm thickness) as spacers, pipette 15 µl of the emulsion into the chamber, and image by fluorescence microscopy at 5–20 s intervals for at least 5 min (typically 500 ms exposure for GFP and mCherry) at room temperature (~25 °C). Min waves are stable for ≥10 h, allowing observation of many positions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare coverslip chamber with double‑sided tape (~90 µm spacer)
Image with fluorescence microscope: 5–20 s intervals, ≥5 min, 500 ms exposure, 25 °C
